name: herd-delegation
description: Delegate one unit of work to an agent in its own Herdr tab and drive that pane as a real terminal: when a pane beats a background subagent, the tab-per-agent rule, the brief with an ask-in-the-pane clause instead of a stop clause, a report file asked for up front, the review pane, the context threshold on reuse, and what a pane changes for the two things that stay with the parent (secret values, human consent). Builds on agent-delegation and on the reference that herdr --skill prints.
